notes: Committed alongside a shared log. A reader whose supported protocol < this protocol degrades to READ-ONLY and surfaces an upgrade notice rather than corrupting. min_reader is the lowest envelope version a current reader must understand.
compaction: `ledger.sh compact` bumps compaction_epoch and writes the recomputed projection state (task queue with status, latest decision per subject, open questions, max_seq) to <repo>/.coordkit-bus/compacted-<epoch>.json. It is a SNAPSHOT, not a truncation: the append-only log is never rewritten and no event is ever removed, so any reader can still recompute the same projections from the log alone. compaction_epoch exists only to let readers tell snapshots apart.
